name: Commonwealth Solar
old_description: Commonwealth Solar is proud be to ranked 9th in Kentucky and 127th in the Installer Rankings for the USA.   Moving forward with service excellence is top priority and already has Commonwealth Solar in position to be one of the top installers in the state for commercial installations, and in the top 200 for 2026.  We look forward to another great year and many more excellent commercial installations.
about:
Commonwealth Solar operates from Wilmore, Kentucky, where it has built a reputation as a dedicated solar installer serving both commercial and residential customers. While the company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, it positions itself as a locally focused enterprise committed to creating Kentucky jobs and keeping installation crews in-house rather than relying on subcontractors.

The firm specializes in turnkey solar projects of any scale, guiding clients through a five-step process that begins with a utility bill analysis and ends with system commissioning. Its installers follow a nationally recognized Gold-standard certification program, and every installation carries a 30-year independent component warranty. The company emphasizes the use of high-grade equipment designed for maximum lifespan and offers ongoing communication and support for the life of each system.

Commonwealth Solar serves businesses across Kentucky seeking to optimize operational expenditures through solar energy, as well as homeowners pursuing energy independence. Its commercial installation track record has earned it a ninth-place state ranking and 127th nationally among U.S. installers, with a stated goal of reaching the top 200 nationally by 2026.

The company's stated mission centers on honest, transparent, and affordable solar solutions delivered with a personal touch. Its "Commonwealth Guarantee" promises customized designs, best-value pricing, reliable lifetime support, and adherence to high moral and ethical standards—differentiators the firm says set it apart in a market often driven by volume over service.
